candidate_program.name: population_scaled_pressure
candidate_program.rationale: Blends active conflict count with rival reward measured in units of the current population's average reward. Native aggregates provide global scale without another residual scan; the average can obscure concentrated heavy rivals.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.65 * degree + 0.35 * conflict_weight * remaining_count / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
